title: Saved Cross Section top styles bypass current canonical membership
observed: Global deletion removes definitions, aliases and picks; both UI list paths and saved state retain deleted styles. Reproduced all twelve example names with only LO/BMB sources.
fix: Reconcile style/list/state membership to current global definitions at load, refresh, list assembly, dialog accept and persistence; preserve surviving styles and valid unpicked definitions.
regression: Actual global delete -> focus refresh -> both lists -> dialog accept -> save/reopen, plus stale explicit source and surviving unpicked definitions.

title: Pending local pick targets can survive removal from the global definition set
classification: confirmed conditional path, not established screenshot cause
observed: _new_tops entries absent globally are retained and appended to pick targets; direct helper execution confirms ASTN remains offered when seeded as a pending draft.
fix: Reconcile draft lifecycle against explicit definition creation/deletion; require deliberate recreation rather than silently offering a deleted global target.
regression: New draft -> first pick -> delete global definition before target rebuild -> no deleted target after refresh; explicit later New top may create definition.
